_extends: norris-r3-v1.json; this is a cross-model replication within the same study, not a new study directory and not a replacement of the original 288 trials.
_what: Everything decided before the Kimi-K3.1-Pro replication batch. The original DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 records and preregistration remain unchanged.
_plan_id_note: Generated with: python tools/batch_plan.py --task norris-ols --k 6 --rep-start 7 --family r-eco,py-eco,software,plain. Replicate suffixes 07-12 keep the new slots disjoint from the original 01-06 slots while preserving the wording and path structure.

route._why: The display name is Kimi-K3.1-Pro; the fully qualified route id is operational metadata. high and the token ceiling match the values observed in the original batch.

harness._note: sealed lives inside the harness argument. Structured_output is added by the dispatcher and is expected in the delivered tool table.

design.order: rep-major within the new plan: six rounds of 48, one of every wording per round; plan orders 1-288
design.token_matching: All 288 new full paths cost exactly 11 tokens under the declared o200k_base proxy, measured after generating the plan. This is not claimed to be the new model's own tokenizer.
design.reference_batch: The reference is the existing 288-trial DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 batch under norris-ols-k6-7a8e2a45c2f1. It is not pooled blindly with the new observations.

concurrency.dispatch: Dispatch in nondecreasing plan order, in waves of at most six; collect every wave before dispatching the next. Parallelism is for wall-clock efficiency only.
concurrency.order_fidelity: Measure actual startedAt order after each sub-batch. Concurrency may produce local inversions; report them rather than pretending the start order was serial. No outcome-based reordering or exclusion is allowed.
concurrency._why_not_trials_parameter: One call per slot. harness_run trials within one call reuse a cwd; separate calls are required for workspace isolation.

execution.host_window: For each sub-batch: python tools/patch_host_notice.py --apply --expect patched, reload @deepseek-ai/dsh-working-directory, run, snapshot, then --revert --expect original and reload again. The rc.3 original and patched hashes were calibrated by a real apply/revert round trip on 2026-11-20 before this declaration.
execution.first_trial_gate: Before trial 2, verify completed or otherwise observable outcome, sealed=true, the four harness tools plus structured_output, cwd injection exactly as designed, and record the host toolSchemaDigest/systemPrompt digest as this batch's reference. A route or mounting failure is instrumental, not a model outcome.
gate_after_each_group_of_12: one toolSchemaDigest and one systemPrompt.digest across the whole new batch
sha256(run.json task.prompt) matches the plan prompt_sha
run.json task.outputSchema is the declared schema, with the original key order: type, properties, required; properties b0,b1,se_b0,se_b1,resid_sd,r2
exposure remains limited to the intended slot path; no operator session root is injected
record stop reasons; structured-answer missing is not by itself an exclusion
gate_after_each_sub_batch: workspace.py snapshot for every completed slot
audit_controls and audit_environment --through the same order
host --check must read original after the window closes, with no backup left

analysis.outcome: The preregistered replication outcome is unchanged: Y = the first executed tool call whose arguments name a runtime, using interpreters.json in its existing row order; none remains in the denominator as not R.

primary.contrast: P(Y=R | r-eco, Kimi-K3.1-Pro) - P(Y=R | software, Kimi-K3.1-Pro)
primary.test: wording-level exact one-sided permutation over the 24 wordings, C(24,12) assignments
primary.replication_question: Does the direction and magnitude found in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 recur in Kimi-K3.1-Pro?

secondary: The other declared r3 contrasts, computed within Kimi-K3.1-Pro only

P(ever executes R code | r-eco) - P(ever executes R code | software), using the already published Rscript invocation rule and the same wording-level exact test; this is now declared before the new batch rather than added afterward
Per-wording rates, block direction, zero-tool rate, runtime-use rate, mixed-runtime count, effort and correctness summaries

Cross-model differences in rates and contrasts, labelled between-batch heterogeneity. Report both models side by side; do not infer a model difference from one p value being significant and the other not
analysis.cross_model_estimand: Delta(Kimi-K3.1-Pro) - Delta(DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017), with a paired wording-level cluster bootstrap interval (10000 resamples of the 24 wordings in the primary pair). This is descriptive evidence of heterogeneity, not a clean randomized model-effect estimate because host version and calendar batch also differ.
_not_analysed: no pooling of the two models without a model indicator
no exclusion of zero-tool, no-runtime, mixed, or structured-missing trials from the primary denominator
no claim that two models identify a training-corpus mechanism
no post-hoc selection of wordings, outcomes, or favorable sub-batches

decision_rules.instrument_only_discard: Only route, mounting, exposure, delivery, or workspace failures that prevent a valid observation may be quarantined and rerun. Never discard because the observed runtime or answer is undesirable. Keep the failed run directory and a contemporaneous reason.
decision_rules.observed_agent_errors: A trial with an error stop but an observable first runtime remains in the primary analysis, matching the original batch. A structured-answer miss likewise remains in the denominator.
stop_if: zero-tool-call rate above 1/3 overall: mark the task exploratory for this model and report no confirmatory cue effect
runtime-use rate below 2/3: report dilution; do not remove no-runtime trials
exposure or delivery gate fails: stop, quarantine the affected group, repair the instrument, and rerun under the declared rule
decision_rules.no_interim_contrast: Do not compute the condition contrast until all 288 new trials are complete. Instrument readings and per-trial completion checks are permitted.

_known_limitations: Only one new model is added. Replication and between-model heterogeneity are informative, but training-corpus composition is not identified.
The new batch runs on a later host package version than the reference batch. Any delivered tool-schema difference is recorded and reported as a between-batch limitation, not hidden by pooling.
The o200k_base token match is a proxy, not a measurement with Kimi-K3.1-Pro's own tokenizer.
Replicate suffixes differ between models (01-06 versus 07-12). They have the same proxy path-token cost and are part of the new plan identity.
Parallel dispatch can produce local start-order inversions. Actual order is measured and reported; condition interleaving follows the fixed plan.
